acceptance_limit: No implementation, performance improvement, final integration or scientific acceptance is claimed by this feasibility review.

expected_structural_cost.limit: This is a structural count estimate, not an observed speedup. Initial inventory/scientific verification, permission and SQL costs remain.
expected_structural_cost.publication: All existing publication canonical-reader subloads remain. Only the two repeated final-stage portions are reduced from2N to2U.
expected_structural_cost.simple_ordinary_source: With no recursive Run inputs, current ordinary load count is 4N over HTTP; proposed count is N+2U, with U distinct successful exact sources. Twenty items from one source: 80 to22; one item:4 to3.

external_only_precheck.assessment: Safe to remove the batch outer load if canonical artifact_segment receives a private keyword flag defaulting False and tests it immediately after its own existing load, before any built-in dispatch or evidence verification.
external_only_precheck.current_lines: runs.py2352-2356 outer duplicate load; canonical load at2409-2410
external_only_precheck.failure_precedence_note: Canonical authorization runs before its load. This can move an already-revoked/denied actor refusal earlier than the old outer eligibility load; that is the existing canonical owner boundary and must not disclose bytes.
must_preserve: Every initial item still invokes the decorated canonical reader, including current inspect authorization and transitive/retained inventory proof.
The batch passes the private flag True; ordinary individual calls preserve their existing default and qualified built-in reader behavior.
Keep current unsupported/400 meaning for built-in batch items, existing per-item errors/order and overall selector/byte caps.
Do not return a loaded Run from the batch layer or reuse a prior loaded Run as authorization.
Keep shared catalog/SQL deadline and private copy/semantic checkpoints unchanged.

final_authority_deduplication.assessment: Deduplicate source identities only within each invocation of final_authority, keeping both domain-return and HTTP-delivery invocations fully fresh.
final_authority_deduplication.key: Entire exact source, including kind and Run ID or every field of the complete publication Ref; use existing canonical encoding or an exact tuple. Never key only by run_id, artifact name or item key.
must_preserve: No cache of authorization decisions, loaded Runs, transitive proofs or attached-Ref results across stages or requests.
Keep global current inspect/deadline/cancellation checks before and after every final stage, even for all-error batches.
For every distinct successful source at each stage, reload current Run, require current inspect, authorize transitive inputs, and for publication revalidate the exact Ref and published attachment.
Final-stage failure discards all buffered results; do not downgrade it into a per-item error.
Initial per-item canonical reads/auth remain independent, including repeated sources.
Keep response schema validation/serialization before the HTTP delivery fence and keep whole-file hashes provisional.
final_authority_deduplication.ordering: Preserve last-occurrence order: A,B,A becomes B,A. Rebuild the seen set within each final_authority invocation.

meaningful_qualification_required_after_.case: Real duplicate-source HTTP round trip and load trace
meaningful_qualification_required_after_.criterion: Multiple artifacts/segments from one completed external Run retain exact order/hash/bytes and every initial canonical call. On a simple source, observe N+2U source loads with two independent final-stage proofs; record count and payload I/O, not just wall time.

Use a completed external source and a recovered exact Ref with repeated items. Every initial reader still runs; each exact source is checked once per final stage, and errors/whole hashes are unchanged. Distinct source kinds/Refs must not collapse.

In an actual HTTP fixture, inject a named source-A transitive/attachment failure when final validation reaches B. The later A proof must run and abort the buffered response; this distinguishes last-occurrence dedup from unsafe first-occurrence ordering. Repeat at post-serialization delivery.

Revoke the actual credential after output validation/serialization for a duplicate-source batch and require a top-level refusal with no items/data. Retain existing current transitive-denial and attached-Ref delivery fault tests. A later separate call after authority loss must refuse.

A built-in batch source must be refused unsupported/400 before built-in payload access; qualified individual built-in reads keep their old path/default. Wrong hashes, missing outputs and failed ordinary Run reads retain their per-item outcomes; every initial read stays canonical.

Exercise initial-item interruption, domain-final interruption and post-serialization interruption. Preserve complete buffered-response discard, shared deadline, no fallback/replay and unchanged Run/grant/reservation/events.

Preserve the complete immutable 99741e5 matrix. Measure the refined candidate in a new exact-head receipt, alternating individual/batch order under equal catalog/inventory/history conditions for1 and20 items and the selected histories. Record SQL/load/byte counts, spread and whole-hash equality. Do not infer a speedup from removed calls.
Prior full public contracts, selected pin, individual-reader defaults and caller method compatibility remain unchanged; production delta stays inside Runs eligibility/final-authority control flow.

race_semantics: A set captured outside final_authority would survive domain return into HTTP delivery and incorrectly skip the fresh delivery proofs: blocker.

First-occurrence dedup A,B,A -> A,B removes the old late A refresh. If a source-specific transitive/attachment fault appears while B is checked, A could become stale before return. Preserve last-occurrence order at the same dedup cost.
Existing final validation is a sequence of current per-source checks, not one atomic all-source ACL snapshot. The refinement must not advertise atomic snapshot semantics.
Mutable facts must be fetched again at HTTP delivery; exact-source identity is not itself an authority proof.
remaining_gates: Root admission after immutable paired matrix exits.
Implementation and meaningful actual qualification on a new frozen source.
New paired measurements; the reported current batch slowdown remains valid for99741e5.
target: Proposed M4 duplicate-load and final-authority reduction
